## Professional Background
Gilang Pambudi Wibawanto is a web developer and software engineer from Malang, Indonesia.
He holds an Applied Bachelor's degree in Business Information Systems from State Polytechnic of Malang (Polinema), graduating in 2025 with a GPA of 3.61/4.00.
Currently working as a Software Developer Staff at PT Green Energi Utama (Feb 2026–present), focusing on ERP systems with CodeIgniter.
